This head unit does not identify as GWM, Haval or B11.
Use the GWM route on this head unit
For GWM firmware that does not name GWM, Haval or B11. Leave off on any other car.
GWM outputs need Android 8.0 or newer.
Display over other apps: not allowed. The cluster and HUD windows need it.
Roundabout direction for phones that only send the older turn events. On for Australia.
Android Auto map on the cluster
Shows the navigation app\'s cluster map (Google Maps, Waze) on the selected display. The main Android Auto screen stays on the centre display. Applies on the next connection.
Navigation card, music card and instrument strip over the map. Off shows the map alone.
DiAuto turn card (top centre). Google Maps always adds its own card, so this is off by default
Instrument strip: fuel and range, speed, odometer
Map labels and car marker size

Google Maps draws its own small cards into the cluster video, so they cannot be moved or removed. DiAuto keeps the car marker in the band between the navigation card and the instrument strip; the custom navigation card is drawn from Android Auto\'s navigation data and can sit anywhere.
Turn arrow in the HUD arrow area
Arrow, distance and arrival time while a route is active. The car keeps showing speed and its own readouts.

The windscreen only shows the HUD\'s small arrow window. With the grid on, note which lettered cells you can read (columns A to J are a tenth of the width each, rows 1 to 5 a fifth of the height each), then set the arrow area below to cover them. The orange box shows the current area.
Show test pattern on the cluster display
Press a steering-wheel button. Each shows the car\'s code here. To use one in Android Auto, assign it in Settings → Keymap while Android Auto is connected; unassigned codes are ignored.
No display other than the centre screen is visible to DiAuto.
